item.title: Embracing Nature: How Modern Art Led to Becoming a Matagi Wife
item.description: Modern art led me to a life I never expected – becoming a Matagi wife. This unique journey began in the serene mountains of Niigata, where I was deeply inspired by the harmonious way of life, influenced by ancient traditions and nature itself. In Kumakata, I documented my experiences through a migration diary, capturing the essence of rural living. The village is known for preserving one of Japan’s three ancient textiles, ‘Uetsu Shina-fu,’ a traditional craft that is on the brink of extinction.
